attributes.name: Enslaved Blue Dragon
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, each character at this location attempts a Dexterity or Acrobatics 14 check. Characters who succeed are dealt 2 Electricity damage; characters who fail are dealt 1d4+1 Electricity damage.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
